description: Bundled academic developer pack including GitHub Copilot Pro, partner cloud credits, domain registrations, and monitoring tools for verified students.

requirements.payment_method_notes: No card required for GitHub Pack enrollment; individual third-party partners may have their own billing verification rules.

validity.auto_renewal: Academic status requires re-verification; paid GitHub Pro reverts unless subscribed.

restrictions: Requires academic verification (school email or dated student ID / enrollment letter).
Bundle contains both 100% free tools and time-limited discounts/credits — check each partner term.

eligibility.conditions: Verified degree/diploma-granting secondary or higher-education students aged 13+.

claims.quote: Free access to GitHub Pro, Copilot, and partner developer tools for verified students.

verification.notes: Distinguish completely free GitHub Copilot benefit from third-party partner discounts.
